user_reported_bug:
I did my own hands-on test pass on the preview before we deploy. Found real bugs to fix - please address all of these:

1. Scenario approval gate doesn't actually pause. Ran scn.sfdc_arch end to end - it went straight to "STEP 14/14 100% COMPLETE" with "Human decision: auto_approved" without ever visibly holding for a human click. This was supposed to be the centerpiece fix from Task 1 - the scenario needs to genuinely stop at the Human Approval Gate step and require an explicit Approve/Reject click before continuing, not silently auto-approve.

2. Scenario completion summary has placeholder zeros that contradict each other: "Sourced 0 candidates across 4 sources", "Parsed 0 resumes", "Drafted outreach for top 0 candidates", "Screened 0 candidates. 2 advanced" (screened 0 but 2 advanced makes no sense). Please wire the actual counts into the completion summary text.

3. Hiring Intake brief analysis failed 2 out of 2 times when I tested it (Salesforce Architect Austin brief) - both times it hung on "AGENT REASONING..." then showed a raw Cloudflare 502 error string directly in the page content area. This is Task 2's centerpiece - please add automatic retry (2-3 attempts on 502/timeout) and a graceful error state with a "Try Again" button instead of leaking the raw Cloudflare error text into the UI.

4. Recruiter Copilot pipeline intel strip shows "AVG FIT 0%" even though individual candidate fit scores are 0.85-0.9+. Fix the average calculation.

5. World State page /world - sub-tabs (Organization, Departments, Teams, Candidates, Offers, Skills) still don't switch the displayed table - clicking any of them keeps showing Jobs. This was flagged as fixed earlier but isn't fixed in the current build - please verify and actually fix the tab-switching logic.

6. AI Interview Suite candidate list has a data bug: several candidates show the title "Senior Senior Engineer" (duplicated word), e.g. Kevin Bennett, Emily Patterson, David Long, Ashley Bennett. Fix the title generator so these read correctly.
summary: Focused verification completed for the 6 reported bugs. Bugs #1, #2, #4, #5, and #6 are fixed in preview. Bug #3 is only partially fixed: UI now shows a friendly error with Try Again and does not leak raw Cloudflare HTML, but the Salesforce Architect Austin intake happy path still fails with repeated 502 responses and never renders the handoff button.

critical.issue: Salesforce Architect Austin brief returned Cloudflare 502 on 4 direct attempts in testing (each after ~60s), so the intake happy path is still unavailable.

integration_issues.issue: Frontend retry/friendly error fallback works, but job architecture handoff never renders because /api/intake/analyze keeps returning 502.

action_items: Fix /api/intake/analyze so the Salesforce Architect Austin brief succeeds end to end and renders data-testid='job-arch-handoff-btn'. Frontend-only retries are insufficient while the backend/upstream continues to time out/502.
Keep the existing friendly intake-error + intake-retry-btn behavior; it correctly avoids raw Cloudflare HTML leakage.
critical_code_review_comments: No relevant testing skill found during mandatory skill lookup.
HiringIntake.jsx contains 3-attempt transient retry and friendly fallback source logic, but the runtime endpoint itself still returns Cloudflare 502 repeatedly for the reported brief.
seed_data_creation: No seed data created. Used existing demo recruiter login and seeded LevelShift data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use /app/tests/iteration_4_backend_verification.py for API checks. Backend evidence: scenario exe_7e0010a8a55d held awaiting_approval for 8.4s with countdown 599.3→590.9s, then completed with approval_decision='approved'; completion outputs were Sourced 11, Parsed 3, Drafted top 2, Screened 3/2 advanced. rca_of_the_issue: Bug #3 remains partially unresolved. The frontend retry and graceful error handling are present and visible, but the underlying /api/intake/analyze request for the reported Salesforce Architect Austin brief consistently times out at the ingress/Cloudflare layer with 502 after about 60 seconds. Because the endpoint does not return a successful analysis, the user-visible happy path still fails and job-arch-handoff-btn does not render. No APIs were mocked.
